messages:
alex_w: Heads up — I want to roll the runtime toggles for the next perf experiment: enable flash_attention_v2, enable speculative_decoding_v1, and toggle kv_prefetch=aggressive for a canary. Need to coordinate scope + guardrails. Who's got capacity to own telemetry and rollback hooks?

maria_g: I can own telemetry and rollout ops. Proposed plan: 5% canary, US-W region only, models < 2B excluded (we saw regressions on small models last time). Instrument p95 latency, error-rate, and GPU mem OOM counts.

jin_k: Quick compat note: flash_attention_v2 currently has a fallback path for older kernels but speculative_decoding relies on a new kv-index API — models need KV-enabled runtime build. We should gate speculative_decoding to model families: rwkv/* and gpt-family only for now.

samira_p: Product question — will Dedicated customers see this change? We need explicit opt-in for Dedicated/private due to change in inference determinism. Also want a banner to customers if we flip on speculative decoding (it can change tokenization alignment in edge cases).

alex_w: Good point. Plan: hosted API 5% canary; Dedicated = opt-in flag in tenant settings. Private/on-prem: don't auto-enable.

maria_g: Guardrails: abort rollout if p95 latency increases > 12ms OR error-rate > 0.8% OR new OOMs > 1 per hour on canary nodes. Add auto-fallback to flash_attention_v1 and disable speculative for that model if triggered.

jin_k: I'll add model compatibility check in admission path: returns "unsupported" if kv not initialized. Suggest adding metrics: speculative_decode_failures (counter) + kv_cache_misses.

alex_w: Can someone add the feature-flag control commands to the runbook? Proposed CLI commands:
```
# enable 5% for hosted prod us-west
redwood-ffctl set flash_attention_v2 on --env=prod --pct=5 --region=us-west
redwood-ffctl set speculative_decoding_v1 on --env=prod --pct=5 --region=us-west --models=gpt-* --models=rwkv-*
redwood-ffctl set kv_prefetch aggressive --env=prod --pct=5 --region=us-west
```

maria_g: I'll add those to the runbook and the rollback commands:
```
redwood-ffctl set flash_attention_v2 off --env=prod --region=us-west
# fallback by model
runtime-admin mark-model-fallback --model MODEL_NAME --kernel flash_attention_v1
```

deploy-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/3284 — adds flags, metrics, and a canary config. CI: ✅, staging: ✅. Use /deploy canary to run rollout once flags are set.

oncall-bot: Scheduled maintenance window for canary rollout at 2024-05-20 02:00 UTC — expected 30m. Notify oncall if guardrails trip.

samira_p: Also add a note in the changelog and inform support — we should include recommended troubleshooting steps when speculative causes hallucination flips.

jin_k: One more ops item: pin kernel build to tag `kernel-2024-05-15` on canary nodes. flash_attention_v2 has a kernel selector change. I'll update the deployment manifest.

alex_w: Sweet. Action items:
- maria_g: implement telemetry dashboards + runbook (owned).
- jin_k: admission/gating + kernel pin (owned).
- deploy-bot / eng-runtime: coordinate canary window and run rollout.
- samira_p: customer comms + changelog.
I'll cut the rollout 2 hrs after dashboards look healthy. Ping me when dashboards are wired. :thumbsup:

maria_g: Wired dashboards and alerts: https://console.redwood/instrumentation/dashboards/flash-attn-canary — alert channels #eng-runtime and #oncall.

alex_w: Ready to flip in 2h. Starting gradual enable in 10m in staging then prod canary at window.

maria_g: Staging looks good — latency neutral on large models, small model exclusions working. Starting prod canary in us-west now.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started. 5% traffic to flagged handlers. Monitor https://perf.redwood/canaries/1716223345

maria_g: Canary time 10m check: p95 +3ms, errors +0.02%, no OOMs. Still green.

alex_w: 30m check: p95 +2ms, errors +0.05%. No regressions. Proceed to 20%?

jin_k: I'm +1 to 20% for hosted, hold on Dedicated opt-ins. Remember to keep speculative off for models that hit decode-failures > 10/min.

samira_p: Approved to increase, support notified, changelog updated.

maria_g: Increasing to 20% now.

deploy-bot: Rollout updated: flash_attention_v2 now 20% in us-west.

maria_g: Final: metrics stable, no OOMs, speculative_decode_failures =~ 0. We will leave flags at 20% for 24h and then schedule full rollout if stable. Closing thread once postmortem window is clear. :white_check_mark:
